thread:
Alex: Quick sync — cutover window for audit-log ingest to use KMS/HSM is planned for 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-14. Need owners for: keystore plugin rollout (API compatibility), HSM attestation/key provisioning, and evidence upload. Who owns what? Any blockers?

Sara: I'll coordinate the compliance side. @Devon (platform) @Mike (eng-infra) please call dibs. Also need to know if vendor maintenance impacts attestation.

Devon: Platform can own keystore plugin rollout + migration plan. PR for plugin v2.1.0 is open (https://github.com/redwood/keystore/pull/4987). Currently failing a flaky test `TestKVExpiry`. If that gets fixed, we can push to staging Thu 4/9 evening.

Mike: Eng-infra will own HSM attestation + key provisioning. Heads up: vendor maintenance scheduled 2026-04-10 00:00–06:00 UTC which may block signature ops. Need to confirm if remote signing works during maintenance. I'll reach out to vendor and report back in 2 hours.

Lina: Staging resources note: we only have an overnight slot free 4/9 → 4/10 (23:00–03:00 UTC). Daytime slots are booked. Can do smoke + attestation run overnight, otherwise bump cutover.

Sara: Evidence requirements for SOC2: audit-bot expects artifacts: `signed_hsm_attestation.pem`, `key_rotation_manifest.json`, `ingest_checksum.txt`. Deadline for upload: 2026-04-13T23:59Z. audit-bot please confirm exact path and checksum format.

 audit-bot: Upload target: gs://redwood-evidence/soc2/q2/keystore-cutover/. Required files: signed-hsm-attestation.pem, key-rotation-manifest.json, auditlog-ingest-checksum.txt (sha256). Metadata: include `attestation_time` ISO8601 and `vendor_cert_chain.pem`. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/SOC2/evidence-spec

Alex: Proposed decision path by EOD today: 1) @Devon fix flaky test + merge PR by EOD tomorrow 4/7 23:59 UTC; 2) @Mike confirm vendor maintenance impact within 4 hours; 3) @Lina reserve overnight slot 4/9 23:00–03:00; 4) @Sara prep evidence upload checklist. If any fail, fallback cutover 2026-04-16 → 2026-04-18.

Devon: Ack. I'll prioritize the flaky test and post status. If the test requires an integration tweak, I'll open a hotfix branch.

Mike: Ack. Vendor contacted — they say signing is degraded during maintenance window, but there's a possibility of a queued offline attestation; need vendor ops approval. I should have final by +3h.

Lina: Slot reserved 2026-04-09 23:00–03:00 UTC. Reply with exact smoke test timeframe and I'll coordinate infra access.

Sara: Drafting checklist now. Will include exact filenames, expected checksum command (`sha256sum`), and presigned upload steps. Posting shortly.

Devon: Quick note — keystore PR includes a cache TTL tweak. If we change TTL before migration, we need to run long-tail expiry tests. That could add ~4 hours to staging run.

Alex: Good call. If TTL tweak forces longer test, we should still be able to fit within overnight slot if we start at 23:00 sharp. @Lina hold that slot tightly.

Mike: Vendor just replied: no guaranteed signing during maintenance. We should plan for attestation after 4/11 if we want a clean stamp. That would push evidence upload to 4/14, which violates audit-bot deadline. Two options: 1) get vendor to whitelist our attestation during maintenance (ask now), or 2) move cutover to 4/16 window. I'm escalating.

Sara: If vendor can't whitelist, legal needs to approve an out-of-band exception for evidence timeline. I'm looping in legal and product now.

Alex: OK — holding until Mike's escalation. If we get vendor whitelist by +6h, we keep Apr12 cutover; otherwise we shift to Apr16. Thanks everyone. I'll track action items in the runbook.
